notes: However you word a complaint, Crisp now hears the same thing. "The video feels washed out" used to take colour away — the opposite of what you meant — while "the video looks washed out" added it back, and "it feels shaky" reached nothing at all while "it is shaky" stabilised. Saying a clip feels, seems, appears or was some way now works exactly like saying it looks that way. Asking for a look on purpose still applies it: "give it a faded look" still takes the colour down.
